note: Pair clear % on L7-L10 with the run's signature pair in hand. The gate rule was 'pair >= 60%', a floor with no ceiling — a run at 100% solves itself the moment you hold both cards. Tyler's band is 60-80%.

coverage.note: Tyler 2026-09-07: the ladder should encompass every ability. Six player-facing cards never appear in any rung's kit, so a player who only plays the ladder can never hold them. Four runs looked like they closed the gap — but measurement killed two of them: The Switchback does not work at all (53% worst even with its own pair) and The Perch is unwinnable (0% with everything). So rabies-dart and bishop-step currently have NO working run to carry them onto the ladder.

endless.how: Roll 5 random abilities from all live cards, then play levels that never stop getting harder. No win state, no retries: it ends when you die, and your score is how deep you got.
endless.ramp: Rookie 1-3, Normal 4-6, Hard 7-9, then Nightmare from 10 with +1 enemy per turn and -1 move every 4 levels, forever.
endless.pool: 120 levels from the 12 broad-kit runs. Combo runs are excluded entirely — a random kit cannot beat a level only one specific pair opens.
endless.where: Gold ENDLESS strip under DAILY REVENGE on the Revenge tab.

difficulty.headline: The four difficulty modes are decorative on every run you can currently play.
difficulty.detail: First all-difficulty measurement ever taken: 60 full runs per run per mode. Eleven of the twelve live broad-kit runs clear 100% on every level at every difficulty INCLUDING Nightmare, with zero deaths. All 13 measured runs have at least one pair of adjacent modes within 8pp. No inversions — a harder mode is never easier, it just isn't harder.
difficulty.worst: revenge-13 is the opposite failure: Hard 7%, Nightmare 5%, effectively unwinnable, and the wall is L2 rather than the finale.
